metadata.title: ARM Holdings near-term technical outlook: bearish setup with key levels to watch

content.text:
Investing.com -- Arm Holdings ADR (ARM) is in a bearish near-term setup. It closed at $161.56 on Nov 24 at 3:59 PM EST, then indicated $152.00 pre-market on Nov 25 at 7:23 AM EST.
Trend Still Heavy
The evidence is clear: daily, weekly, and hourly gauges all show Strong Sell.
-
Daily RSI is 38.20 and weekly RSI is 38.49.
-
Daily MACD remains negative, with a histogram near -0.07.
-
Price sits below the daily 20 SMA at $188.67 and 50 SMA at $236.77.
-
Daily ATR is $17.40, meaning ordinary volatility is unusually large.
The stock is oversold on several oscillators, but oversold is a condition—not a reversal signal.
Levels That Matter
Immediate defense: The daily S3 pivot is $158.80. A break below it would expose the recent low near $157.25, followed by the weekly Camarilla support zone around $148.42–$144.63.
First repair: Reclaiming the hourly pivot near $162.23 would stabilize the tape. A move above $165.50 would improve the very short-term structure.
Real resistance: The daily pivot at $177.24 is the first meaningful recovery hurdle. Until price recovers that area, rallies remain countertrend.
Catalyst Meets Valuation
The selloff has both technical and fundamental fuel. A semiconductor-sector shock tied to Intel's weak outlook pressured Arm Holdings ADR (ARM) and peers. Read more (Oct 30, 2026).
Arm later beat fiscal Q2 expectations, but the stock still fell as investors focused on royalty visibility and high expectations. Read more (Nov 5, 2026).
Near-Term Read
Base case: Bearish continuation while below $165.50, with $158.80 and $157.25 as the immediate downside checkpoints.
Bull case: A sharp oversold rebound could target $170.90, then $177.24. That would be a relief rally, not a confirmed trend reversal.
Risk case: A break below $157.25 could accelerate selling toward the weekly support band. The combination of high volatility, weak momentum, and elevated valuation leaves little room for disappointment.
